info.name: Shoreline Buildings API Copy- minimized DB
info.description:
Documentation for the minimized version of the Shoreline Buildings GraphQL API, showing requests that can be used to test the API.

Tests can be run from the commandline using:

`npx newman run .postman_collection.json -e .postman_environment.json`

## 💥 Error handling

Errors are returned in the `extensions` field of the GraphQL error response, with a `code` and `classification`.

| Exception | Code | Classification | Message |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | `BAD_REQUEST` | `ValidationError` | Exception message |
| `IllegalStateException` | `CONFLICT` | `ConflictError` | Exception message |
| `EntityNotFoundException` | `NOT_FOUND` | `DataFetchingError` | Exception message |
| _(any other exception)_ | `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | `InternalError` | `"Internal server error"` |

---
